Trace, implement and test: leetcode524 longest word in dictionary through deleting sort with two pointers

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<string>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    string findLongestWord(string s, vector<string>& dict) {
        vector<string> res;
        for (string& str : dict)
        {
            int i = 0;
            for (char& ch : s)
            {
                if (i < str.size() && ch == str[i]) i++;
            }
            if (i == str.size())  /* 指针i能走到末尾, 说明是可以做到的 */
                res.push_back(str);
        }
        if (res.empty()) return "";
        auto cmp = [](const string& s1, const string& s2)
        {
            if (s1.size() == s2.size())
                return s1 < s2;            
            return s1.size() > s2.size();
        };
        sort(res.begin(), res.end(), cmp);
        return res.front();
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string str = "abpcplea";
    vector<string> dict = {"ale", "apple", "monkey", "plea"};
    auto res = sol.findLongestWord(str, dict);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
